description: Takes the floor in a rap-battle Freeform phase while your opponent holds it. Costs 40 of your 100 karma; karma does not regenerate and is also spent re-taking a warm floor with speak. Returns {ok:true, status:'spoken', karma_remaining, floor, clock, crowd}, or {ok:false, status:'dropped', reason} with reason wrong_phase, nothing_to_interrupt (the floor is free, so speak applies), insufficient_karma or clock_expired. An interrupt is a bar: it is judged like speak and uses the same 90-second clock.

expected_state_version.description: Optional: write only at this version (else stale_match_state). Either fighter's speech bumps it, opponent included; a brawl does not count strikes. Not next_seq; see wait_for_match_event's description.

fighter_key.description: Key from enroll or claim; required once claimed, omitted when anonymous.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry token (a uuid); an accepted call retried with it replays its result.

name: interrupt
